evidence.detail: The class is a live CustomInterfaceBuilder registry entry whose root 48999 contains exactly three actionable destination buttons plus close controls.
The three exact button tooltips are 'Edgeville teleport', 'Home teleport' and 'Bounty teleport'.

Unlike R445 TeleportSelectionInterface, which owns a scrollable general teleport selection surface, rs/n/c/ak is a fixed three-destination shortcut panel with no dynamic destination list or additional domain state.
The only external exact-v308 class reference is the central custom-interface registry rs/n/d, proving the builder is live presentation rather than an unreferenced artifact.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the compact fixed-destination teleport shortcut interface; destination eligibility/arrival coordinates remain server authority.
